nodes.name: Associated functions/consts without `Self` in signature do not inherit implied bounds from the impl header
Implied outlives bounds are computed from a queried type `ty`, but in these associated items the relevant impl `Self` well-formedness context is not propagated

code_elements.name: implied_outlives_bounds

nodes.name: `ImpliedOutlivesBounds` only carries a single `ty`, which can miss header-implied relationships like `'b: 'a` when no explicit signature type reintroduces them

code_elements.name: ImpliedOutlivesBounds

nodes.name: Logic in implied outlives bound computation is isolated in the type-op path, contributing to missing integration with associated item checking context
Underlying implied-outlives inference implementation may fail to recover bounds from the impl header alone, especially for WF checks of `Self` and signature-free bodies
